product_contract: Expose every meaningful derived/predicted metric with its support, definitions and interactive views; inventory gaps rather than invent outputs.
Shared one-game lineup context across boxes, advanced stats, conditions and replay.
Regular season, Cup and Playoffs are core competition sections; Players/Teams remain shared tools.
Expand conditions, advanced rates, heatmaps and outcome exploration; diagrams are examples, not a feature ceiling.
Keep controls grouped, secondary detail collapsible, tables sortable and primary navigation free of Lab.

current_data_census.scope: retained2026-27 master; no dynamic Cup/play-in/bracket scheduling yet

rules_notes: 2026-27 Cup semifinals are higher-seed home games; final neutral Indianapolis. Prefer dated current-season league announcements over stale team landing pages/FAQ dates.
Group games already count toward regular82. QF/SF fill TBD league slots; Cup final excluded from league records/stats. Add30 league games to1200, not2 beyond82 per team.
22 nonqualifiers each need2 games;4 quarterfinal losers each need1; league QF4+SF2 complete remaining30. Canonical event simulated once even when both Cup and league.
Exact unpublished pairing/travel algorithm is unknown: freeze feasible matching assumptions, label and sensitivity-check; official fixtures replace slots.
Use Cup regulation-only differential/points rules; team pathway currently stores regulation scores plus a separately resolved winner, requiring explicit final/OT semantics.
Play-in produces16 playoff teams; best-of-seven fixed bracket, no reseeding, correct2-2-1-1-1 hosts, stop at4 wins;15 series and1 champion per world.
Existing all-teams-equal-scheduled invariant is competition-scoped: partial80-game league schedules and unequal postseason game counts are legitimate.
limits: Only two bounded learned possession families; preserve MODEL qualification caps/protected test.
No pathway calibration retune, broad rewrite, new provider or historical forecast backfill.
Postseason path mechanics do not establish historical calibration.
Inspiration references concern presentation; they do not authorise ingesting new data sources.
